body.name: Vmap
body.def: \(V(P)=\operatorname{Var}_P\{\lim_{n\to\infty}\sqrt n(\widehat z-z(\theta))\}\), with pre-block mean blocks \(\Omega_{\varepsilon\varepsilon}/p_\ell\), covariance-moment block \(\Omega_{qq}\), their same-block cross terms inherited from \(\Omega\), and post-donor mean block \(\Omega_{\varepsilon_D\varepsilon_D}/\lambda\).
